topic: Battery and energy-storage realism for electric RC vehicles: cell/pack models, RC-scale LiPo evidence, over-discharge damage, ESC/flight-controller battery behaviour and telemetry conventions
note: Local copies live in the gitignored references/battery-energy/. Guide: docs/research/battery/BAT-00/README.md. Plan: docs/plans/battery-realism.md. No file here is a measurement of a pack the simulator flies.

files.license: Copyright the authors / EVS24; free proceedings download. Reference only.
files.use: Modified-Shepherd generic model (Li-ion, NiMH, NiCd, lead-acid) with filtered-current polarisation and exponential zone; parameters from three points of a datasheet discharge curve. Candidate datasheet-tier template path (BAT-05) and NiMH receiver-pack template.

Over-discharge mechanism: no discernible change when stopped early, a voltage plateau near -12 % SOC, Cu current-collector dissolution and internal short circuit beyond it. Anchors the severe band of the BAT-21 damage model; tested cells are large-format, not RC LiPo pouches.

files.license: NASA-authored work; free download from NASA DASHlink. Reference only.
files.use: 33 % Edge 540T electric aircraft, four 18.5 V 6000 mAh Li-Po packs, 30 Hz per-pack V/I/T logging, flight loads as short pulses up to ~80 A, ~25 min ground-emulated flights, end-of-discharge prediction with a 2 min landing margin. RC-scale evidence for relaxation (RC) behaviour and for remaining-time alarms; no released raw data found.

files.license: NASA NTRS public document. Reference only.
files.use: Edge 540T powertrain pack test bed: 5S2P Li-Po pouch packs, per-cell thermocouples, emulated flight loads. Template for the BAT-27 pack characterisation card.

files.license: Article CC BY 4.0. Dataset licence on Mendeley (doi 10.17632/stcppt2r68.1) not yet verified.
files.use: BAK LP-503562-IS-3 Li-Po, 3.7 V 1.1 Ah, five cells at 25 C: capacity tests, partial discharges with 300 s rests (pseudo-OCV ladder), EIS 0.2-5000 Hz and a fitted R0 + 2 R-CPE + Warburg + L model across SOC and SOH down to 70 %. Candidate free source for the Li-Po template and for R0/SOH trends (BAT-05).

links.note: Galeotti Li-Po EIS/capacity/ECM data. The public API returned non-JSON; download through the web page in BAT-01 and record its licence.
Kollmeyer et al., LG 18650HG2 (3 Ah NMC) drive cycles at -20...40 C (McMaster). Li-ion template candidate; licence not confirmed in the search snippet.

Bauersfeld & Scaramuzza, range/endurance for multicopters: grey-box Li-Po model, 1.3 % (43.1 mV) cell-voltage error. Already summarised in DR-01; arXiv non-exclusive licence, cite numbers only; E_cell units to verify.
Suti, Di Rito & Mattei 2022, 6S 1850 mAh fixed-wing Li-Po HPPC and hysteretic Thevenin model. Inspected in EL1a-R1/02-battery.md.
Di Nisio et al. 2023, 4S 10 Ah UAV Li-Po test and discharge model. Inspected in EL1a-R1/02-battery.md.
PyBaMM (BSD-3): Thevenin ECM with lumped thermal model and parameter sets (e.g. Chen2020 LG M50). Offline oracle and template generator only.
Free BPX DFN parameterisations (NMC111 and LFP graphite cells); offline LFP/NMC reference curves via PyBaMM. Licence to record in BAT-01.
PX4 battery estimation: load compensation with an internal-resistance estimate (BAT1_R_INTERNAL, typical 5 mOhm per cell), V_EMPTY/V_CHARGED. Model for radio-side remaining-capacity estimates.
Betaflight cell-count auto-detection from vbat_max_cell_voltage (4.30 V), warning and critical per-cell thresholds (docs give 3.5/3.4 and 3.3 V). Behaviour lookup only; GPL code is never copied.
EdgeTX sensors and calculated Cell formula (Lowest cell from Cels). Naming/semantics for the BAT-14 sensor emulation and the BAT-28 log reducer.
Molicel P42A 21700: 4.2 Ah, 2.5 V cutoff, 30 A continuous (45 A with 80 C monitoring), ~16 mOhm DC at 10 A. Reseller figures; fetch the official Molicel datasheet in BAT-01.
UAF thesis: LiCoO2 lithium-polymer model to -20 C; apparent cold capacity loss mainly from increased internal resistance.
